detrend_method_null: identical degree-3 detrend applied after the circular velocity shift, before the lag sweep
detrend_method_real: degree-3 polynomial regression on block index, residual kept, per channel and per velocity dimension, within each trial
detrend_scope: within-trial polynomial detrend; never crosses trial boundary

read_rule_reference.detrended_flattens_or_sign_breaks: Arm P stops, and the lag route is closed.
read_rule_reference.detrended_peak_moves_to_100_150: The raw peak was drift-contaminated; the real lead is canonical. Report the detrended latency as the candidate.
read_rule_reference.detrended_peak_near_260_360: The lead is real at that latency. Report it as a candidate global lag.
read_rule_reference.detrended_rises_at_40: Open boundary. Do not widen again. Do not call it a candidate.
